buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms.

2. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 3. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. OEM Item Specification Compliance Bidders must quote their rates for the exact HP OEM Model Numbers (e.g. Q2 612A, W1660A, W1370A, etc.) requested in the Bidding Document / Financial S heet. No 'Equivalent', 'Compatible', 'Refilled' or 'Remanufactured' products will be accepted. Only Original HP Products will be accepted. 2. Product Verification & Anti-Counterfeit Measures The HP Security Hologram / QR Code on each cartridge box must be comple tely intact and untampered upon delivery. The Buyer Department will verify the authenticity of each serial number through the HP SureSupply App / QR Cod e Verification System before accepting delivery. Strict administrative action will be taken if counterfeit goods are found. 3. Execution and Rejection Criteria If even one cartridge in a supplied lot is found to be duplicate, used, or refilled, the entire lot will be rejected. In such a case, the supplier will be required to rep lace the original product at their own expense within 7 days, otherwise, an inci dent will be created against the vendor as per GeM rules and action will be initiated to blacklist them. 4. Delivery and Shelf Life The successful bidder (L1) must deliver the goods to the consignee's location wi thin 15 days of the GeM contract being generated (or as per the agreed deadli ne). The manufacturing date of all cartridges supplied must not be older than 6 months from the order date. 5. Price Inclusiveness Quoted rates are final and include GST, freight, delivery charges, insurance, and all costs of delivery to the consignee's office. No additional or additional claims will be accepted. 6. Warranty and Support Clause

Standard OEM Warranty: All HP toner and ink cartridges supplied must carry the full standard manufacturer's warranty in accordance with the HP Limited Warranty Statement . Warranty Coverage Period: Ink Cartridges: The warranty is valid until the ink is completely depl eted or the "Warranty Ends" date printed on the cartridge is reached. LaserJet Toners: The warranty will cover all defects in materials and workmanship until the toner has completed its estimated life (Page Yi eld). .
